items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I think Clarence Muse (INSONIC) got in on that, but they were, I think, the real writers of it, you know. But Clarence did it and featured it and, you know, sold it for them.

ctx.x: Well, Leon and Otis were very successful, you know, musicians. They wrote some wonderful things. Leon, incidentally, wrote that swallows, "The Swallows Come Back to Capistrano," and they wrote, "Sleepy Time Down South," and I think Clarence Muse (INSONIC) got in on that, but they were, I think, the real writers of it, you know. But Clarence did it and featured it and, you know, sold it for them. So -- he gets credit for that, you know. But -- (Recording interruption)
Okay, you were talking about the René brothers. Go on.
